# X100 fixed fixtures

`tiny-cn.zmind` and `complex-style.zmind` are committed regression fixtures generated by
`scripts/x100-fixtures.ps1`. They are intentionally small enough for source control and cover
Chinese text, tasks, labels, notes, links, relationships, boundaries, summaries, floating topics,
cards, multiple shapes and mixed hierarchy depth.

`target/x100-fixtures/perf-20k.zmind` is intentionally generated on demand because it is large and
fully reproducible. It uses deterministic node ids and a four-way tree shape so performance runs
can compare the same corpus across builds.

The `manifest.json` file records byte size and SHA256 for the latest generation. Regenerate only
when the fixture generator changes; record the new hash in the round report and explain the data
shape change.
